description: This file defines FastAPI routes for processing and retrieving analytics data. It includes endpoints to ingest analytics events, retrieve a summary of analytics, and an admin endpoint to get analytics volume by type. It interacts with database models such as AnalyticsEvent, Notification, Comment, Message, RSVP, and User.

classes.name: AnalyticsSummary
classes.description: Response schema for the analytics summary endpoint

methods.name: dict ingest( payload: AnalyticsIngest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Accepts an analytics event payload and stores it in the database.

methods.name: AnalyticsSummary summary( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Returns a summary of analytics, including counts of RSVPs, comments, messages, unread notifications, and event views.

methods.name: dict admin_volume( limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200), db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.admin, UserRole.moderator)), )
methods.description: Returns a count of ingested analytics grouped by type for admin/moderator users.
